note.p: Thomas Baker was a bookseller residing in Southampton from 1767 to 1805 according to the British Book Trade Index. He was a part of Baker and Fletcher booksellers on the High Street in Southampton according to Holdens directory 1811. Thomas Baker had his eldest son, Thomas, whose will dates 1806. On 2 August 1811, Godwin was at Cowes on the Isle of Wight, took a packet, and dined at Stow. On 3 August 1811 he saw Castle and Platform, called on Baker, sailed to Netley Abbey, near Southampton, and took the coach to Winchester.
